svg.title: Two vantage points, one comparison
svg.desc: Of 136,260 node-seconds of recorded downtime, 127,580 (93.63%) were seen by both the provider and the tenant probe, 100 only by the provider and 8,580 only by the tenant. Disputed nodes: gpu-012 5,400 s tenant-only, gpu-009 3,000 s tenant-only, gpu-005 120 s tenant-only, gpu-003 60 s each side, gpu-016 40 s provider-only.
